title: File creation and later access are separate checks

steps.label: Requested mode
steps.detail: Program requests 0666 for a regular file

steps.label: Creation policy
steps.detail: umask 0027 clears bits; default ACLs change rules

steps.label: Access check
steps.detail: Credentials, parents, ACLs and MAC still apply

method: Conceptual ordinary creation example:0666 & ~0027 =0640; directory 0777 becomes 0750. Excludes default ACL inheritance.
alt: Requested mode is filtered by creation policy, then later access depends on process credentials and other controls.
